The screen shows the Clipper app with a clipboard service started and instructions on how to copy to clipboard using ADB shell. To copy the text "john.doe@example.com" to clipboard, I should first long-press the EditText field to bring up the selection/context menu, then select all and copy. The EditText is at [0,275,1080,2216].
